newsitem.title: USA: Arrow sees gross margins improving in 2H.
newsitem.headline: Arrow sees gross margins improving in 2H.

text.p: Arrow International Inc said on Wednesday that it expected sales growth to slow due to the continued strengthening of the dollar, but also that shipments of recently introduced products should aid year-on- year sales comparisons in the next two fiscal quarters.
The new products include implantable infusion pumps, NarrowFlex intra-aortic balloon catheters and 2 French mapping catheters for electrophysiology, the company said.

Arrow also said that gross margin on sales should continue to improve in the second half of fiscal 1997. It based this on anticipated higher margin sales mix and increased use of lower cost, international manufacturing facilities, although it said changes in dollar exchange rates could diminish expected improvement.
It cautioned the improvement is likely to be offset by higher research and development costs.
The company said its M-3000 infusion pump is building market share in the chemotherapy market and it believes the product is positioned for substantial growth.

It said its expects its NarrowFlex intra-aortic balloon catheter to contribute to sales growth in the third and fourth fiscal 1997 quarters. It does not expect full worldwide distribution of its its 2 French catheter system for mapping electrical signals in the heart until the fourth fiscal 1997 quarter.
